candidates.title: Hetis: Serving LLMs in Heterogeneous GPU Clusters with Fine-grained and Dynamic Parallelism
candidates.reason: Heterogeneous-GPU serving system with fine-grained dynamic parallelism, head-granular attention placement on low-end GPUs and online dispatch balancing network/compute/memory intensity; reports up to 2.25x throughput and 1.49x latency improvement.

discovery_stats.axis: heterogeneous GPU serving・fine-grained dynamic parallelism・online dispatch
